text: The detective for your code. Your AI agents search the same files all day; unumsearch keeps the clues.
A trigram-indexed search engine for code and files that answers like ripgrep, usually in milliseconds, for AI coding agents and humans.
unumsearch is built into OpenUnum: its search tools use the daemon and fall back on their own.
Animated story header for unumsearch: the sourced hook and one-liner, the install quickstart, a race row comparing ripgrep at 347 ms with the daemon at 64 ms, the OpenUnum fit, and the end card.
